item.description: Sexual harassment between peers begins as early as Grade 4 and continues throughout lower secondary school. item.title: Workplace AI adoption remains slow, informal and uneven, survey finds
item.description: Despite the rapid development of generative AI and the high level of public interest, the use of AI in the day-to-day work of many employees is not yet the norm. This is the finding of the third wave of the Konstanz AI study, for which a total of 1,105 employees were surveyed in May 2026. The proportion of employees who use AI in their work rose only slightly from 35% to 38% compared with the previous year. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Power breeds suspicion: In cases of wrongdoing, people point to leaders more quickly
item.description: People with power are more quickly singled out as the culprit when something goes wrong but it is unclear who made the mistake. That is shown by a series of studies by researchers at the University of Amsterdam. In one, they analyzed almost 100,000 everyday conflicts on the Reddit page "Am I the Asshole?" According to the researchers, people with power are more readily blamed because others think they can "get away with anything." The findings are published in the Journal of Personality and Social Psychology. Fuente: Phys.org.
